definitions.reference: Analytic simulator output including configured baseline drift; before noise, artifacts, clipping and rounding.
definitions.scale: Nominal unmodulated simulator breath peak-to-peak amplitude; constant per scenario.
definitions.coverage: Percent of the 3000 one-minute samples assigned a direction and bin; intervals [start,end). Record end=11999 leaves the endpoint unassigned.
definitions.spread: On exactly the time/fixed common assigned samples of each seed, sqrt(sum within-group squared deviations / sample count) / scale * 100. Groups = direction x bin (10). Mean over contributing seeds; lower means more concentrated reference signal amplitude, NOT organ position accuracy.
definitions.filter_nrmse: sqrt(mean((filtered-reference)^2))/scale*100 on quality-valid one-minute samples, pooled over seeds.
definitions.filter_error_p95: 95th percentile of absolute point error/scale*100 on quality-valid samples, pooled over seeds.
definitions.bounds: Floor-rank P5/P95 of quality-valid filtered samples inside record; shared across all cycles, re-estimated per seed.
definitions.missing: No common binned samples -> null spread, not zero. Valid samples / bin coverage do not prove physiological correctness.

raw_comparison.population: Quality-valid samples in each 60-second record; raw means the observed input including noise. These are differences, not errors versus truth.
raw_comparison.mae: Mean absolute filtered-minus-raw difference at the same timestamp, no lag compensation. Report physical simulation units and percent of that run raw P95-P5 span. Arithmetic mean over runs.
raw_comparison.span_change: 100 * ((filtered P95-P5)/(raw P95-P5)-1), both on identical valid samples. Arithmetic mean over runs; negative means narrower amplitude span.
raw_comparison.lag: Maximize demeaned within-region normalized cross-correlation over +/-500 ms on the 20 ms grid. Positive means processed later. Only contiguous valid regions with >=2 nominal periods after both 500 ms guards; same raw anchors for every lag; require correlation >=0.5 and non-search-edge maximum. No estimate is null. Median signed lag across eligible runs; P95 absolute lag and count also retained.
raw_comparison.limitation: Whole-waveform alignment is not individual extrema timing or frequency-specific phase response. Zero grid lag cannot establish zero local timing error.

reference_comparison.reference: Sampled local extrema of the full analytic noise/artifact-free waveform, detected independently by scipy.signal.find_peaks with no smoothing or thresholds. Includes baseline drift and preset amplitude modulation. Never uses production extrema or build_respiratory_bins.
reference_comparison.time: Split each clean reference extremum-to-opposite-extremum half-breath into five equal time parts; rising=inhale. Reference unavailable outside complete reference halves.
reference_comparison.fixed: Classify the clean value directly into five equal amplitude bands using the SAME per-run app bounds; add clean reference direction. Clean value outside bounds has label -1 and counts as mismatch if actual fixed assigned a bin.
reference_comparison.population: Exactly the same quality-valid samples assigned by both actual modes and inside a reference half-breath. No reference amplitude-in-range restriction. Denominator and number of contributing runs are always reported.
reference_comparison.mismatch: Actual direction/bin differs from its own method reference direction/bin, or actual fixed assigns a bin outside the clean reference amplitude range. Pooled counts over 20 runs, percent of scored samples.
reference_comparison.limitations: Compares agreement with each method own reference, not common physiological target or CT quality. Does not score unassigned samples as correct. Synthetic apnea/weakening retain 8 percent oscillation; reference labels here do not establish clinical apnea detection.
